Key constraints:

Need support outstanding MAX_TRANS per master. Need per-ID ordering. Need handle DECERR for unmapped addresses. To avoid head-of-line blocking, we could have per-slave B skid buffer? Actually slave B channel is single, so if we don't accept B because target master FIFO full, we block all B from that slave.
